title: Safe Swap
statement: Implement `solve(items, i, j)`. Return a new list where the values at indexes `i` and `j` are swapped. Do not change the input list. One unpacking assignment is enough. Indexes are in range and may be equal.
constraints: items is a list of integers
i and j are valid indexes
hints: Unpack the two positions in one assignment.
Swapping an index with itself is a no-op.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Tuple unpacking swaps two slots without a temporary name.

editorial: Tuple unpacking swaps two slots without a temporary name. Copying first keeps the caller's list intact, which is the difference between a pure function and an in-place edit the caller did not ask for.
reference_solution:
def solve(items, i, j):
    out = list(items)
    out[i], out[j] = out[j], out[i]
    return out
